Not one of his picks

Nothing on Adam's list matches that search.

Every pick above was explicitly called a favorite, recommended, or named as a daily tool on Adam Savage's Tested — Favorite Tools, Favorite Things, Ask Adam, One Day Builds, his book Every Tool's a Hammer, and his ILM / MythBusters toolbox list, read 9 Nov 2026. Each Amazon link is the exact link from that video's description. Where he linked the maker's own site instead, that link is shown. His storefront: amazon.com/shop/adamsavagestested · His own shop: adamsavage.com

Buy-line prices were read from his Amazon links on 9 Nov 2026 and change often — the price on Amazon is the real one. Where a price couldn't be read, the link is shown without one. Used on camera but never explicitly recommended, so not in the grid: Festool TS 55 track saw, Dremel rotary tool (his rotary pick is the Proxxon), Prusa i3 MK3S, and a dated 2013 EDC roundup (Omega Seamaster, Fenix L1P, Fisher Space Pen, Paul Smith billfold). No source was found for Starrett, Hakko, Benchmade, Foredom, Sherline, Klein, or Really Useful Boxes as his picks — his measuring picks are Mitutoyo, Brown & Sharpe, and SE. Product photos come from maker and retailer product pages.

Not affiliated with Adam Savage, Tested, or Amazon.
